source: DPWH contract agreements (scanned PDFs) via dcs.infrawatch.ph
method: pdftoppm at 300 dpi then tesseract --psm 6, twice: plain text and a second pass reconstructing rows from word coordinates, unioned. No vision model and no API key — these scans are readable by ordinary OCR, which keeps the tier free, offline and reproducible.

visibilityNote.surface: at the surface when finished — measurable in 0.3 m imagery
visibilityNote.footprint: outline visible from above; thickness and volume are not
visibilityNote.ground: visible only from beside it — this is what street level is for
visibilityNote.buried: under ground or under a surface course when finished
visibilityNote.inside: cast into the concrete — invisible forever
visibilityNote.gone: the item is removal; nothing remains to see
